evidence: Ter. Eun. 2.2.33: philosophōrum habent disciplīnae ex ipsīs vocābula (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 25, 32: vocābula Latīna ēdidicī, I memorized the Latin vocabulary
terms.comment: Vocābulum is a name or word for a thing.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 25, 32, checked against the searchable text of the book.
